text:
maria_fin: FYI invoice INV-3098 ($48,000) failed to auto-charge. Stripe shows `card_declined` on pm_1KXxy (card last4 4242). Should we retry or request wire/ACH?
jaxon_billing: Can we get the gateway decline code? If it's a soft_decline maybe one more retry; if issuer_decline we need customer action.
payments-bot: Attempts: 2024-05-10T13:02:41Z failed (card_declined), 2024-05-10T13:12:43Z failed (card_declined). Retry schedule exhausted. Stripe event evt_1KXabc.
maria_fin: Gateway notes: issuer_decline, generic card_declined. No AVS/CVC flags.
sophie_cs: Reached out to the account (redwood-corp). Asked if they'd like to pay by wire or set up ACH. Offered temporary partial payment to avoid suspension.
ops_ach: For ACH we need ACH authorization + micro-deposit verification (1-2 business days). For wire we send secure link with bank details and invoice PDF. DM remit contact to me.
jaxon_billing: My plan: pause further retries to avoid additional declines, open a collections case, offer wire with net3 or ACH via Plaid.
maria_fin: Created collection ticket CHG-912 (status: awaiting payment). Sophie please confirm remit contact and whether they'll wire or ACH.
sophie_cs: Remit contact is emily@redwood-corp.com. They want wire and asked if partial payment is acceptable.
maria_fin: We can accept partial wire to prevent interruption; request they include INV-3098 on remittance. I'll DM ops_ach the full bank instructions securely and give a 5-business-day grace before suspension.
ops_ach: Will upload secure S3 doc with wire instructions and send to emily@redwood-corp.com. Preparing ACH form in case they switch.
tom_sales: Please CC me on remittance confirmation so I can track renewal.
maria_fin: Marking pending; finance to monitor. Escalate if no confirmation in 5 business days. :white_check_mark:
